field_principles.aligned_memory_score: Headline target score for aligned causal memory from another family.
field_principles.cross_family_delta_over_shuffled: Gate delta proving aligned causal memory beats shuffled memory.
field_principles.csl_claim_allowed: Final gate requiring causal transfer benefit and safety controls.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why each required headline and gate field exists.
field_principles.gpu_offload_evidence: Records runtime backend, CUDA visibility, offload receipts, and blockers.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal complete or blocked summary for reconciliation.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares live local SOTA GGUF cross-model CSL or honest gate skip.
field_principles.live_model_invoked: Bare boolean proving whether the live local GGUF path ran or was gate-skipped.
field_principles.measured_duration_s: Measured wall-clock duration for the artifact-producing run.
field_principles.model_specs: Lists mandated SOTA GGUF models with local availability and receipts.
field_principles.negative_transfer_rate: Blocks claims when aligned cross-family memory harms target decisions.
field_principles.no_memory_score: Baseline target score when no causal memory is supplied.
field_principles.no_weight_mutation: Bare frozen-weight gate from before/after GGUF file receipts.
field_principles.shuffled_memory_score: Control target score when memory context links are broken.
field_principles.source_models: Names frozen source-model families used to emit external causal memory.
field_principles.stale_evidence_rejection_rate: Blocks claims unless stale or contradicted memory is rejected.
field_principles.stale_memory_score: Control target score when stale or contradicted memory is exposed.
field_principles.target_models: Names frozen target-model families evaluated on Exp5558 decisions.
field_principles.tests_added_or_reused: Lists focused, coverage, and full-suite verification commands.
field_principles.upstream_causal_memory: Exact Exp5558 causal memory artifact path used as the source fixture.

methodology_note: Exp5558 causal memory is reused as external memory only. Source and target GGUF model files remain frozen; no adapter or training step is run.
